content: Clearly, since the references are divergent, the model cannot be expected to produce the entire table, and we see some false information being hallucinated after training. Nevertheless, as we show in § SECREF36 , this system can be used for evaluating generated texts. After training, we can parse the output sequence along the special tokens INLINEFORM0 R INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 C INLINEFORM3 to get a set of (attribute, value) pairs. Table TABREF54 shows the precision, recall and F-score of these extracted pairs against the ground truth tables, where the attributes and values are compared using an exact string match.
